solutions.title: Index search
solutions.strategy: Find each character's index in the keyboard string as it is typed.

timeComplexity.explanation: Each of w word chars can scan k keyboard chars.

spaceComplexity.explanation: Only the current position is stored.

solutions.title: Position map
solutions.strategy: Precompute character positions and sum absolute movement.

timeComplexity.explanation: Build positions once and scan the word once.

spaceComplexity.explanation: The position table stores one entry per keyboard character.
